claim_statement: Subspace Separation Ratio rho_sep quantifies geometric contrast via ratio of mean between-cluster separation to within-cluster dispersion, converging toward 1 under distance concentration
verification_method: Evaluated across 7 noise dimensions x 3 geometries; drops from 2.466 to 1.002
action_taken: Reconciled unsquared scale-invariant Euclidean distance definition in Eq. 1

claim_statement: Continuous symmetric unimodal distributions have population Sarle bimodality coefficient BC <= 5/9 approx 0.556
verification_method: Analytic proof via continuous uniform distribution (gamma=0, kappa=1.8 -> BC=5/9)
action_taken: Verified proof and boundary conditions (Remark 1)

claim_statement: In a balanced 2-component Gaussian mixture 0.5 N(-Delta, sigma_0^2) + 0.5 N(Delta, sigma_0^2), BC > 5/9 iff component separation Delta/sigma_0 > sqrt((3+sqrt(15))/2) approx 1.854
verification_method: Exact algebraic derivation solving 2*theta^2 - 6*theta - 3 > 0 for theta = (Delta/sigma_0)^2
action_taken: Algebraic proof verified and checked numerically

claim_statement: Analytical failure regimes of marginal moment screening: bounded uniform/beta, zero-inflated sparse counts, non-linear XOR parity, small N < 100
verification_method: Mathematical analysis of moment inflation and sampling variance in Fisher sample kurtosis estimator
action_taken: Documented and validated with Madelon and PBMC68k experimental failures

claim_statement: BGSS selects candidate pool min(D, max(K, max(100, floor(alpha * D)))) with default alpha = 0.15
verification_method: Evaluated top_frac = min(1.0, max(0.15, 100/D)); on Leukemia (D=7129) retains exactly 1069 genes
action_taken: Verified that implementation exactly matches algebraic definition

claim_statement: Quadratic sample determinacy sum_{j} S_{ij}^2 evaluates exactly via base-partition contingency tables in O(M^2 N + M^2 K^2) time and O(N + K^2) memory without materializing dense N x N matrix
verification_method: Algebraic identity sum_j S_ij^2 = (1/M^2) sum_{m1,m2} C(pi_m1(i), pi_m2(i)); tested against brute force (error <= 7.11e-15)
action_taken: Verified identity across 9 parameter grids and degenerate empty-cluster test cases

claim_statement: Auxiliary working memory complexity of bipartite GAC pipeline is O(NL + L^2), decoupling auxiliary consensus memory from O(ND) data storage
verification_method: B rectangular matrix requires NL words, W_anchor requires L^2 words, P_stack requires MN words
action_taken: Formal complexity proof audited and validated

claim_statement: Benchmark suite consists of 13 multi-domain datasets evaluated across exactly 3000 total model fits (30 seeds on 6 high-D cohorts, 10 seeds on 7 other cohorts across 12 pipelines)
verification_method: Row count verified: (6x12x30) + (7x12x10) = 2160 + 840 = 3000 model fits with 0 missing values
action_taken: Audited and verified via tools/check_consistency.py

claim_statement: Omnibus Friedman test across all 13 benchmarks shows no statistically significant difference among evaluated clustering pipelines (chi_F^2 = 11.56, p = 0.40, Nemenyi CD = 4.62)
verification_method: Exact SciPy stats.friedmanchisquare on 13x12 matrix of dataset means yields stat=11.5562, p=0.3979
action_taken: Reported honestly; no attempt made to mask or game non-significant omnibus result

claim_statement: K-Means attains the best omnibus mean rank (R=5.15), followed by Standard Consensus (R=5.23), DEC (R=5.23), GAC pipeline (R=5.62), Ward (R=5.69), and CoHiRF (R=7.69)
verification_method: Average mid-rank computation over mean ARI across all 13 benchmarks in Table 9
action_taken: Verified and accurately documented in text and Demšar CD diagram (Fig. 8)

claim_statement: GAC achieves Grand Mean ARI of 0.152, but this advantage is driven by concentrated gains on two cohorts: Leukemia (0.600) and SRBCT (0.546). On the other 11 benchmarks, GAC averages 0.076 with median 0.055
verification_method: Empirical per-dataset ARI means: Leukemia (0.5998), SRBCT (0.5456); 11-cohort mean excl. Leu/SRB = 0.0759; 13-cohort median = 0.0555
action_taken: Documented and acknowledged transparently as an empirical limitation

claim_statement: On Prostate (D=12600), GAC underperforms simple baselines (0.012 vs 0.043 for K-Means and 0.049 for Standard Consensus)
verification_method: Prostate GAC ARI = 0.0123, K-Means = 0.043, StdCons = 0.049, Ward = 0.026
action_taken: Reported prominently as a boundary condition where diffuse signal defeats marginal BGSS

claim_statement: On the six high-dimensional (D/N > 20) cohorts, GAC attains mean rank #1 (R=2.17, subgroup mean 0.217 vs 0.065 for FCAG), but this exploratory finding does not survive Holm-Bonferroni correction (p_adj > 0.05)
verification_method: Subgroup ranks: Leukemia (1), SRBCT (1), CNS (4), Ovarian (1), Colon (4), Prostate (2). Wilcoxon-Holm p_adj > 0.05 due to n=6
action_taken: Qualified explicitly as an exploratory subgroup finding with limited sample size power

claim_statement: Determinacy anchor selection provides no statistically significant benefit over uniform random landmarks (Delta = +0.019, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.039, +0.082], Wilcoxon W=9.0, p=0.84)
verification_method: Exp 8b evaluated across 30 seeds on 6 high-D cohorts: V5 = 0.2168, V4 = 0.1980, diff = +0.0188. CI covers zero
action_taken: Reported as an empirical null result confirming bipartite consensus functions as a compression device

claim_statement: In matched feature gating ablations, BGSS provides an additional +0.062 boost over matched random gating (0.217 vs 0.155, 95% CI [+0.013, +0.142], Wilcoxon p=0.0625), while bipartite ensembling accounts for +0.118 (65.6%) of gain
verification_method: Exp 8c evaluated across 30 seeds on 6 high-D cohorts: BGSS = 0.2168, random gating = 0.1547. Net diff = +0.0621. Wilcoxon W=1.0, p=0.0625. Ambient = 0.0368; ensemble gain = 0.1547 - 0.0368 = +0.1179
action_taken: Authoritative decomposition established; reconciled from potential confusion with V4 random anchors

claim_statement: Million-sample scalability: bipartite anchor consensus scales to N=10^6 in 141-183 s, cutting consensus graph memory by 99.6% at N=10000 (762.9 MB vs 3.05 MB) and peak process RAM by 97.4% (2.61 GB vs 68.9 MB)
verification_method: Controlled benchmark log across N in [500, 10000] and N up to 10^6 on AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX host
action_taken: Distinguished theoretical graph memory (99.6% reduction) from measured peak process RAM (97.4% reduction)

claim_statement: Subsample stability-accuracy gap: on real cohorts, classical and graph baselines show near-perfect stability (>= 0.97) yet zero accuracy (<= 0.03) on Prostate; overall mean gap is +0.464 (95% CI [+0.363, +0.607]) while null stability collapses to +0.007
verification_method: 30 stratified 80% subsamples (435 pairwise overlaps); 10000 bootstrap resamples across cohorts for CI
action_taken: Distinguished subsample stability (overlapping ARI) from full-dataset seed stability (unperturbed)

claim_statement: Structural failure modes: zero recovery on non-linear XOR parity (Madelon ARI 0.010), zero-inflated scRNA-seq counts (PBMC68k ARI 0.182), and multi-class coordinate blending under large K (refuting anchor starvation via Exp 8e)
verification_method: Benchmark results: Madelon ARI = 0.021; PBMC68k ARI = 0.182; Exp 8e budget scaling L=max(40,10K) improved ARI by only +0.009
action_taken: Failure mechanisms analyzed mathematically and empirically verified
